summary: Iter 63 — ElevenLabs Voice-Cloning integration tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases PASS (personas list, TTS synth + 3x cache hit for wlad + musk, validation 400/401/422, admin-only DELETE /api/voice/cache, regression of 11 migrated routes). Real ElevenLabs calls succeeded (audio/mpeg base64, ~110 KB first call, cached <1s on 2nd/3rd). Frontend: WladMotivationCard renders on /dashboard with correct testids + German quote + 'Wlads Daily Drop' label + 'Wlad hören' button; click triggers POST /api/voice/tts → 200 and button flips to 'Stop' state (audio playback started). Quote stable across reload (daily rotation consistent). /challengers page loads without JS errors. 1 MEDIUM backend inconsistency found: DELETE /api/voice/cache only checks user.is_admin flag and ignores ADMIN_EMAILS whitelist, so whitelisted admin (test@test.com) gets 403.

minor.issue: Uses inconsistent admin gate: only checks `user.get('is_admin')` boolean flag, but the rest of the codebase (routes/admin.py line 17) also honours an ADMIN_EMAILS whitelist = {test@test.com, start@aiporate.com, mert@wladbot.com}. Result: whitelisted admin accounts (e.g. test@test.com, which has is_admin=None in DB) cannot clear the voice cache. Fix: import is_admin_user helper from routes/admin.py OR replicate the same check: `user.get('email','').lower() in ADMIN_EMAILS or user.get('is_admin')`.

action_items: MINOR: Align admin gate in /app/backend/routes/voice_tts.py clear_voice_cache() with rest of codebase. Currently only checks user.is_admin flag; should also honour ADMIN_EMAILS whitelist so whitelisted admins (test@test.com) can clear cache. Easiest: `from routes.admin import ensure_admin` and call `await ensure_admin(user)`.

OPTIONAL: OnboardingTour overlay is not suppressed by localStorage flags used in test setup — main agent may want to add a standard test-hook (e.g. ?skipTour=1 query param or localStorage key 'onboarding_skip_for_tests').
critical_code_review_comments: voice_tts.py lazy ElevenLabs client is fine, but `_get_client` caches the instance at module-global level — if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is rotated, pod restart is required. Consider invalidating cache on 401 from ElevenLabs.

voice_tts.py _synthesize uses `b''.join(chunk for chunk in stream)` — fine for short text (max 800 chars), but for >60s audio this buffers entire MP3 in memory. Current MAX_TEXT_LENGTH=800 keeps it safe.

Frontend VoicePlayButton.js uses `new Audio(dataURL)` which is a detached media element — not added to DOM; it works but means auto-cleanup depends on ref. If user navigates away mid-playback, the object may still be held via audioRef and keep playing. Consider audio.pause() on unmount.

WladMotivationCard daily rotation key = `Math.floor(Date.now() / 86400000) % poolLen` — uses UTC day, so users in different timezones may see a 'new quote' at midnight UTC instead of local midnight. Acceptable but worth noting.
DELETE /api/voice/cache has no rate-limit and returns the deleted count with no further filters (deletes ALL cache). Consider allowing persona-scoped deletion: DELETE /api/voice/cache?persona=wlad.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + frontend for voice TTS fully green. Only action item is the minor admin-gate alignment on DELETE /api/voice/cache. All 9 voice personas are mapped in VOICE_REGISTRY (voice_tts.py:45-86) with correct ElevenLabs public-library voice_ids. Cache hit-rate is excellent: 2nd/3rd identical request returns cached=true within <1s. Real ElevenLabs API key in /app/backend/.env works (note: each uncached call costs credits, keep tests deterministic with identical short text). For frontend: to dismiss onboarding on dashboard, click 'Überspringen' text after login (localStorage flags don't fully suppress it). WladMotivationCard rotates via UTC day index so current quote is predictable from new Date().getTime()/86400000 mod 8.
rca_of_the_issue: Admin cache-clear 403: /app/backend/routes/voice_tts.py:219 uses `if not user.get('is_admin'): raise 403`. But the canonical admin gate in /app/backend/routes/admin.py:17 is `user.email in ADMIN_EMAILS OR user.is_admin`. The seeded admin account test@test.com has `is_admin=None` (we confirmed via GET /api/auth/me) so voice_tts.py rejects it. Fix: replace the check with `from routes.admin import ensure_admin; await ensure_admin(user)` or inline the same logic.
